title: Wait for the restore-to-bottom transition to actually land before returning, symmetric to the reveal-side wait
action: User field-test finding (2026-07-27/28), confirmed via clarifying question to have happened right after using the nudge buttons: after 'load older', sending a Reply-sheet message would land the typed text but not submit it (no Enter). Same root-cause class as escape-injection-redraw-race-1 (cell -1) but on the exit side: send_text(RESTORE_BOTTOM) only confirms Ctrl+End's bytes reached the pty, not that the agent's TUI has actually finished transitioning out of its own scroll view -- a real keystroke (the Reply-sheet's Enter) arriving during that lag got swallowed as 'dismiss scroll view' instead of reaching the composer. Fix: poll (reusing ESCALATION_READ_ATTEMPTS/ESCALATION_READ_INTERVAL from cell -1) re-reading Visible after RESTORE_BOTTOM until it matches the pre-scroll baseline or the budget is exhausted, before returning -- so by the time a caller's next real action can fire, the pane is already settled. Extended FakeHerdr with a symmetric set_restore_delay test seam (and an ever_scrolled gate so the pristine pre-scroll state, also scrolled:false, isn't mistaken for a lagging restore).

truths: read_history_with_strategy re-reads Visible after RESTORE_BOTTOM instead of returning immediately
the restore-wait stops early once a read matches the pre-scroll visible baseline
a pane whose exit-transition never lands within the budget still returns (does not hang), with the escalated read unaffected either way
a pane's pristine pre-scroll state is never mistaken for a lagging restore (ever_scrolled gate)

artifacts.substantive: restore-wait loop after send_text(RESTORE_BOTTOM), plus 2 new regression tests using the restore-delay seam
set_restore_delay seam + ever_scrolled gate modeling the exit-side lag symmetric to reveal_after_reads

key_links: reuses cell -1's ESCALATION_READ_ATTEMPTS/ESCALATION_READ_INTERVAL constants, no new tunables
prohibitions: no change to the escalated read's own value or to NativeScrollback's behavior
